correctness.rationale: Both the original numerical table and its repaired four-agent restriction are correct. Edge direction is toward the assignment with no greater individual vote count; unchanged houses contribute zero and tied margins create both edges. Simultaneous house renaming fixes the first strict ranking uniquely and all orbits have size 24 in the repair. Independently enumerated every labeled profile, without normalization, using /tmp/opencode/frozen_review_5.py (Python 3/NumPy). For a tested vertex, if it fails to reach some vertex, semicompleteness gives that missing vertex a direct edge to each vertex in the former reach set (no edge can point back to the missing vertex from that set). The seed can thus be replaced until it reaches all. Its predecessor set is then exactly the top cycle. Separately computed Pareto sets by all serial dictatorships: the first deviator establishes efficiency, and in any efficient matching a favorite-house recipient must exist, or pointing to the holders of favorites produces an improving cycle. Remove such a recipient and iterate. Inclusion was checked for every profile. All 42 cells of the frozen RESULT and CSV matched (216 and 331,776 profiles); the four-agent aggregates also matched. The repaired RESULT and CSV are exactly the 35 four-agent cells, and python3 -B /workspace/repairs/5/verify.py independently replays their census by normalized profiles, direct pairwise Pareto dominance and exact reachability, returning VERIFY_OK 35 331776. The frozen code was inspected but not executed. This is an exhaustive finite result, not a general-market law.

value.rationale: The original has a valuable four-agent component, not recoverable from its already covered three-agent table or Pareto marginal. The re-audited remainder concerns two natural assignment correspondences used to study majority selection and efficiency. Its exact coupling quantifies the failure of selectivity with a small efficiency set: a full 24-vertex top cycle with only three Pareto assignments has probability 1/18, and strict containment occurs with probability 11663/13824. This is an interpretable small-market baseline not determined by structural sizes or lottery-support marginals. The four-agent restriction retains the entire motivated new finite universe, not an arbitrary slice of profiles.
